name: travel
description: PRD §9. Exercises agent-attested constraints — the case where a payment is authorized but the agent fails the actual instruction.
intent_text: Book me a refundable nonstop flight to Miami next Friday, under $800.

policy.summary: Book one refundable nonstop flight to Miami for under $800.
compiler_notes: No airline was named, so no merchant allowlist was set; any airline requires your approval.
'Refundable', 'nonstop' and the destination are reported by the agent. Waysafe records the claim on the receipt but cannot independently verify it.

assumptions: Limited this to a single booking of at most $800.
No airline was specified, so any merchant requires your approval before payment.
You will be asked to approve anything at or above $600, below the $800 ceiling.
Set this to expire a week from now, after 'next Friday' has passed.

'Refundable', 'nonstop' and 'Miami' are recorded as agent claims. If the agent books a one-stop nonrefundable fare and reports otherwise, the payment would still go through — the receipt will show the mismatch.
